question_en:
We are selecting an illustration for an article on the history of newspaper printing. Only this photograph was found in the old shared drive. The editor wishes to locate all photographs from the same shooting sequence and then select one that both depicts the equipment and shows multiple people collaborating. Please answer the following questions:

1. Which official catalog record corresponds to the input image? Provide its item ID, photographer, and month of capture.
2. In the official catalog of this collection, find all photographs that share the same photographer and month of capture as the input image, and whose official title matches exactly from the beginning up to the word `newspaper`. How many photographs are in this same group? Check each photograph in this group one by one: which photographs simultaneously satisfy the following conditions: two large, light-colored cylinders arranged side by side in the central foreground, and at least five workers visible in the background? Provide the count of matches, and list the item ID and original negative number for each matching photograph.

Answer Format: Please answer in numbered points (1)—(2); answer both questions in text; for Question 1, provide the catalog record information; for Question 2, provide the total count of the same group, the count of matches, and the item ID and original negative number for each matching photograph.
answer:
(1) item ID: 2017837901; Photographer: Marjory Collins; Month of capture: September 1942.

(2) There are 11 photographs in the same group; 1 meets the conditions, with item ID 2017837879 and original negative number LC-USW3-009026-E.
